verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly suggests replication and HA. A community report describes eBay running a 2-region fully replicated ClickHouse system (clickhouse-comm-13), another praises its robust cluster support (clickhouse-comm-2), and first-party material mentions ClickHouse Keeper as a ZooKeeper replacement (clickhouse-docs-44), with community notes on running Keeper alongside ClickHouse (clickhouse-comm-3). None of the first-party docs in the pack describe adding read replicas or how failover works. Missing for 10: first-party docs on adding read replicas, documented failover and HA behavior (including in ClickHouse Cloud), an explicit link between Keeper and replication, and hands-on failover corroboration.
